title: Demi-Vie
description: Build an underground colony after a nuclear catastrophe. Carve rooms into the rock and reinforce them before they collapse. Assign work, keep the shelter supplied with air, water, food, and heat, and send expeditions to the surface. Keep your people alive long enough to prepare the Exodus.
controls: Left-click to select, click and drag to mark out excavations
WASD, ZQSD, or arrow keys to move the camera
Space to pause or resume, 1–5 to change speed
− and + to change the interface size
